## Summary

**FSQRT** (Floating point Square Root).

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `√<vea> → d` |
| Syntax | `FSQRT.s <vea>,FPb,FPd`<br>`FSQRT FPn,FPb,FPd` |
| Description | Convert source to float if needed. Calculated square root. Stores result in float register d. Fpb is ignored. Vea size is long , Single or double. |
| FP condition codes | see table |

### FP condition codes

| N | Z | I | nan |
|---|---|---|---|
| * | * | * | * |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–9 | `1111110` |
| 1 | 8 | A |
| 1 | 7 | B |
| 1 | 6 | D |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |
| 2 | 15–12 | - |
| 2 | 11–8 | d |
| 2 | 7 | R |
| 2 | 6–5 | Size |
| 2 | 4–0 | `01101` |

- R = 0 then vea , R = 1 then Mode&Register = 5bit float register.
- Size 0=long 1=single 2=double 3=reserved.

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have FSQRT. This page covers only the 68080 addition: a 3-operand form (Apollo FPU, line-F id 6). For the classic forms, the Motorola manual applies.

## Do / Don't

- No rules beyond the details above.
